 An independent group of BTS fans is hoping to raise RM43,200 to illuminate three buildings in Kuala Lumpur purple during the K-pop group's concerts in Malaysia this December
 The fans, who have been sharing updates about the fundraising effort on Threads, hope to use the money to light up KL Tower, TS Law Tower, and Menara Sentral RAC in purple for three nights.
Purple is closely associated with BTS and its fanbase, known as ARMY.
According to posts shared by Threads user @yandyan , the group had previously raised enough money to illuminate KL Tower in purple for one night. It is now seeking additional contributions to fund the larger project.
The organisers are asking fellow fans to contribute a minimum of RM5 each.
 View on Threads 
 At the time of writing, they have reportedly raised over RM17,000 so far
 In one of the posts , the organisers described themselves as an independent fan group hoping to give BTS a warm welcome when they arrive in Kuala Lumpur.
To encourage more fans to contribute, they also shared a screenshot of BTS member RM's Instagram Story featuring Kaohsiung's 85 Sky Tower illuminated in purple, with the message "THE CITY IS YOURS ARMY!"
The organisers expressed hope that BTS members might similarly photograph and share the illuminated buildings in Kuala Lumpur on their social media accounts in December.
 Image via @yandyan (Threads) 
 BTS is scheduled to perform at TM Stadium Nasional in Bukit Jalil on 12 and 13 December 2026.
